title: Dumped by my girlfriend, I turned to martial arts.
alternative_titles: 被校花分手后，我直接武道通神
After the School Belle Dumped Me
I Became a Martial Arts God
summary: Dumped by my girlfriend, I turned to martial arts. Manhua 被校花分手后，我直接武道通神, After the School Belle Dumped Me, I Became a Martial Arts God Fang Yi transmigrated into a new world, only to be dumped by his school belle girlfriend right after arriving. He thought it was just the beginning of a cliché urban romance story… Until the system warned him: “Spiritual energy will awaken in one year. The world will face great upheaval. The apocalypse is coming.” “With a system by my side, why should I be afraid of anything?”
